metadata.article_title: Person entitled to claim refund in certain special cases.

article.title: Person entitled to claim refund in certain special cases.
article.content:
432Person entitled to claim refund in certain special cases.

Section 432  ·  Chapter XX  ·  page 517 of the Act
(1) Where the income of one person is included in total income of any other person under any provision of this Act, the latter alone shall be eligible for a refund under this Chapter in respect of such income.
(2) Where a person is unable to claim or receive a refund due to him, on account of death, incapacity, insolvency, liquidation or other cause, his legal representative or the trustee or guardian or receiver, shall be entitled to claim or receive such refund for the benefit of such person or his estate.
